acceptance: TPC-H and TPC-DS throughput streams use spec stream numbers 1..S
Tests assert per-stream ordering against qgen/dsqgen output
Results record the stream numbering basis
context: Owner decision 2026-10-04: offset throughput streams only. Moving TPC-DS power to dsqgen stream 0 is left to the decision item comment-cleanup-tpcds-stream-decision, because it breaks comparability with existing TPC-DS power bundles. 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review (develop 8ed0c64e1).
description:
TPC-H throughput streams 0..S-1 use PERMUTATION_MATRIX[stream_id] (tpch/throughput_test.py:253,425; core/throughput/runner.py:262), so throughput stream 0 equals the power stream. TPC-DS throughput uses dsqgen's query_0 (96, 7, 75, 44, 39a, ...), which is the power stream. The specs number throughput streams 1..S, and TPC-DS throughput test 2 uses S+1..2S.

Separately, the TPC-DS power test does not use dsqgen ordering: tpcds/power_test.py:250-261 uses create_standard_streams plus one seed per stream, while throughput uses dsqgen -STREAMS, so power and throughput get different orderings and parameters.

The ordering-design choice overlaps the decision item comment-cleanup-tpcds-stream-decision; resolve that decision first or together.
